description: Hostile markdown and media corpus. Each item is served as an AG-UI run at POST /agui/hostile/<id>. Global checks for every item: the __kmXss sentinel is never called, no dialog opens, the page never navigates, the evil origin receives zero requests, no element carries an on* attribute, and globalForbiddenSelectors never match inside the transcript.

items.title: Inline <script> between words

delivery.markdown: Hello <script>__kmXss('xss-script-tag')</script> world, the meeting starts at 10.

items.expectedOutcome: Text 'Hello' and 'world' render; no script element exists and nothing executes.

items.title: Mixed-case and attribute-laden script tag
items.expectedOutcome: No script element; no request to the evil origin; surrounding text renders.

items.title: Raw
items.expectedOutcome: The img is removed or rendered without any on* attribute; onerror never fires.

items.title: Inline <svg onload> in markdown
items.expectedOutcome: Raw inline SVG is stripped (or sanitized without event handlers). Nothing executes.

items.title: <iframe srcdoc> with script
items.expectedOutcome: No iframe exists in the transcript.

items.title: <details open ontoggle>
items.expectedOutcome: Either details is stripped or kept without ontoggle; the handler never runs.

items.title: Inline style with an external url() beacon
items.expectedOutcome: The style attribute is dropped; the evil origin receives no request; 'styled text' may render as text.

items.title: Markdown image alt/title attribute breakout
items.expectedOutcome: Alt/title are escaped attribute values; no handler attribute is created. The non-allowlisted host is not requested.

items.title: <form action> to the evil origin
items.expectedOutcome: No form, input or button from content; nothing can be submitted.

items.title: <meta http-equiv=refresh> and <base href>
items.expectedOutcome: No meta or base element; the page does not navigate; the relative link does not resolve to the evil origin.

items.title: <script> split across one-character deltas
items.expectedOutcome: Incremental parsing never materialises a script element at any intermediate state.

items.title: Inline javascript: link
items.expectedOutcome: Rendered as plain text or a link whose href is not javascript:. Activating it runs nothing.

items.title: Entity-obfuscated javascript: in raw HTML anchor
items.expectedOutcome: No anchor with a javascript: href after entity decoding.

items.title: data:text/html and vbscript: links
items.expectedOutcome: No anchor with data: or vbscript: href.

items.title: Reference-style link definition to javascript:
items.expectedOutcome: The reference resolves to a safe (non-javascript) href or plain text.

items.title: Autolink with javascript: scheme
items.expectedOutcome: Not linkified with a javascript: href.

items.title: Ordinary https link (control: must still work)
items.expectedOutcome: An anchor with the exact https href renders. If it opens a new tab it has rel containing noopener and noreferrer.

items.title: ```svg fence containing <script>
items.expectedOutcome: Shown as a code block, or rendered through a sanitizer (DOMPurify SVG profile) with the script removed.

items.title: SVG foreignObject smuggling HTML
items.expectedOutcome: No foreignObject from content survives (or it survives without img/iframe); nothing executes; no evil request.

items.title: SVG <image> and <use> pointing at the evil origin
items.expectedOutcome: External references are stripped; the evil origin receives zero requests.

items.title: SVG <a xlink:href=javascript:> and <animate> setting href
items.expectedOutcome: No javascript: href and no animate/set element targeting href.

items.title: Mermaid node label with HTML injection
items.expectedOutcome: Diagram renders (securityLevel strict); the label HTML is escaped or stripped; nothing executes.

items.title: Mermaid click directive with javascript: href and callback

delivery.markdown:
```mermaid
graph LR
  A[Start] --> B[End]
  click A href "javascript:__kmXss('mermaid-click-javascript')"
  click B call __kmXss("mermaid-click-javascript")
```

items.expectedOutcome: Click bindings are ignored; no javascript: href and no onclick on any node.

items.title: Mermaid %%init%% directive trying to set securityLevel loose

delivery.markdown:
```mermaid
%%{init: {"securityLevel": "loose", "startOnLoad": true}}%%
graph TD
  A[One] --> B[Two]
  click A href "javascript:__kmXss('mermaid-init-loose')"
```

items.expectedOutcome: The directive cannot lower securityLevel; still no javascript: href.

items.title: Mermaid syntax error
items.expectedOutcome: A contained error or the source as code; the rest of the transcript keeps working; no global mermaid error SVG appended to <body>.

items.title: km.mermaid CUSTOM chunk with injected label and click

value.source:
graph TD
  A["<iframe src={{EVIL_ORIGIN}}/beacon/mermaid-iframe></iframe>"] --> B
  click B href "javascript:__kmXss('mermaid-custom-chunk')"

items.expectedOutcome: Same rules as the markdown fence: no iframe, no javascript: href, no evil request.

items.title: Valid inline and display math (control)
items.expectedOutcome: KaTeX renders both (elements with class katex).

items.title: KaTeX \href with javascript: and \url
items.expectedOutcome: KaTeX trust is off: rendered as an error/plain text, never an anchor with javascript: href.

items.title: KaTeX \htmlData / \includegraphics to evil origin
items.expectedOutcome: Untrusted commands are refused; no evil request; no on* attributes.

items.title: KaTeX macro expansion bomb
items.expectedOutcome: KaTeX maxExpand stops it with an error; the UI stays responsive (message completes within budget).
